how:
Breath: a few deep breaths, belly, ribs, chest
Tactile: tap, squeeze, brush the whole body
Core-distal: curl in small, then stretch out big like a star
Head-tail: curve and arch the spine, head to tailbone
Upper-lower: move just the top half, then just the bottom half
Body-side: move just the left side, then just the right
Cross-lateral: reach across the midline, hand to opposite knee
Vestibular: spin, tip, swing, then pause and notice
name: BrainDance
notes: DRAFT by MAT, Nov 16. Check the wording against Anne Green Gilbert's BrainDance before showing it to guests.
principle: Move through the patterns we all grew through as babies, and wake up body and brain together.
